title: 1990 Bowman Baseball- #2 Tom Glavine Atlanta Braves
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 1990 Bowman Baseball trading card featuring Tom Glavine of the Atlanta Braves. This sports trading card is part of the Base Set manufactured by Topps for Major League Baseball fans and collectors. The card is a non-autographed parallel/variety within the 1990 Bowman series, making it a valuable addition to any collection of baseball memorabilia.
